narrationTexts: I'll take a look at the project structure first to find the pricing test suite.
Let me run the suite and just extract the failure summary rather than the full wall of text.
Found it — `orderTotal` computes tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount (contradicting its own comment). Fixing:
finalText: All 625 tests pass now. The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43` — it taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the function's own comment ("tax is charged on the amount the customer pays"). Fixed by computing tax on `discounted` instead of `cents`; only the 3 order-total cases with both a non-zero discount and tax exposed it.
